title: Screen Owner
empty: No keyboards or mice found. Is the daemon running?

access_why: Some devices have no permissions. A udev rule is needed, and it is written as root.
tip_row: Click for the next monitor, right-click to pick one
err_timeout: The daemon did not answer in time
err_bad_json: Could not parse the daemon's answer

command.label: Daemon command
command.description: Path to screen-owner. The panel calls it with devices, monitors and assign.

privilege_command.label: Privilege command
privilege_command.description: How to install the udev rule: pkexec or sudo. Asked once, on the first grant.
